rule_or_pattern: Drop lines containing a word that begins with a bare capital vowel with no breathing on it (or on the following diphthong vowel): (?:^|[\s(\[«])[ΑΕΗΙΟΥΩ](?![\u1F00-\u1FFF])[\u03B1-\u03C9\u03AC-\u03CE] — the polytonic print always has a breathing there (Ἀ, Ἰ, Ἡ, Αἰ) and Google drops it on capitals. Likely applies to all vouli_parliament_1850s books, not just this one.
notes: Body text reads correctly with full polytonic marks (1, 8-10, 19-21, 25-35, 38, 40). Google systematically drops the breathing on initial capitals: 'Ιω.' (2, print Ἰω.), 'Αναστάσιος' (3), 'Αντωνόπουλος' (11), 'Ιωάννου' (13), 'Αιδωρίκης' (16), 'Ιωάννης' (17), 'Αναγνωσθείσης' (18), 'Ημέρᾳ' (23), 'Απαγγείλαντος' (36) and 'Η Γερουσία' (39). As a result, the signature-list name lines (about half the book, classed greek_mono) are mislabelled. Page p000001 duplicates a page of vouli 9e6fd8368590; the pool dedup rule handles that.
